<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Emergency Regeneration](/Feats.aspx?ID=5526) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=623" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 81

**Archetype** [Wild Mimic](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=226)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Wild Mimic Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5515); you have deactivated a creature’s [regeneration](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=26) for at least 1 round or have identified a creature with regeneration in combat

**Trigger**
You’re reduced to 0 hit points from damage that’s neither [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524) nor [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604).

</column>

---

You have battled against foes whose bodies naturally regenerate, and while yours doesn't do so all the time, it can happen in a pinch. You gain the effects of a 7th-rank [_regenerate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1648) spell. At 20th level, you gain the effects of a 9th-rank _regenerate_ instead.
